rules.name: state
rules.requirement: Retain one generated typed Workspace.State per persistent instance. Do not round-trip a caller-provided state snapshot or use a fresh Wasm instance for every event.

rules.name: user boundary
rules.requirement: Render only generated BoundUserIntent values. Submit them to invokeUser; preserve its modeled applied/stale disposition and message. Resource leases and RuntimeNotice are trusted adapter callbacks, not user-supplied intents.

rules.name: safe text
rules.requirement: Render title, heading, status, labels, item displayName and selectionMeaning as text. Names are not markup or filesystem output paths.

rules.name: buttons
rules.requirement: Render enabled native buttons for Button and SelectedItem controls. Honor keyboardActivate and enabled fields, with ordinary native Enter/Space activation, visible focus and disabled state.

rules.name: files
rules.requirement: Render FileField as an accessible labeled arbitrary-binary chooser. Honor multiple, enabled and updating. Render ordered item groups with safe displayName, ordinal, observedLength, empty and the source remove/earlier/later labels. Buttons submit the exact generated BoundUserIntent. Field groups have FileField.id and can receive programmatic focus even while their chooser is disabled.

rules.name: archive metadata
rules.requirement: selectionMeaning is displayed. Selection labels do not claim filenames, directories or filesystem metadata are encoded or restored; this archive preserves ordered bytes and object boundaries.

rules.name: focus
rules.requirement: Resolve View.focus.target through focusId. Apply focus only when View.focus.serial changes; progress/rerender with the same serial preserves keyboard focus. Focusable field groups, status/result/error regions and headings use the source target IDs. Honor View.live, native Enter/Space button activation and disabled state.

rules.name: selection callbacks
rules.requirement: Picker and collection replies carry the modeled instance/run revision, pickerSerial and slot/order. Immutable collection construction preserves the previous owner until acknowledgment. Stale newly returned leases are released.

rules.name: read/spool
rules.requirement: Execute source-owned Command values only. Exact run, source/destination lease, ticket, offset and bounded extent bind each receipt. Read cancellation keeps its pending request until an exact stopped receipt or actual late read reply; a late nonempty reply still transfers one image ticket to release. Spool creation and seal remain pending across cancellation until their actual receipts. Cleanup cannot delete a source with active read/seal custody. Empty spans own no image ticket. No whole-input arena materialization is assumed.

rules.name: write/storage
rules.requirement: Thread one Storage.State ledger through each serialized job/storage operation; do not start concurrent writers from independent quota snapshots. Reserve before host I/O and admit actual capacity separately. Report achieved partial writes and deletions on failure, releasing only unused reservations. Retired-job callbacks carry the old Run and cannot publish; retiredCleanupComplete cannot forget nonzero retained/reserved storage. Custody transfer uses Storage.transfer after an actual ownership receipt; a publication copy is a separately admitted allocation.

rules.name: physical observations
rules.requirement: Api.Accounting.peakOwnedBytes is the logical arena profile, not physical RSS or staging. Storage.Usage is separate. Optional PhysicalObservation values retain their measured scope and sequence; absence is unobserved, not zero.

rules.name: one arena
rules.requirement: Core operations move one actual Arena, CallerRoots and RuntimeResources.Usage. A boundary-only AwaitingState has controls/roots but no Arena. Detach/reattach only after full event acknowledgment and no pending mutation/release/credit operation; this is an internal typed transfer, not admission of an arbitrary validation snapshot.

rules.name: returned spans
rules.requirement: Each nonempty RuntimeSequence Outcome.span transfers one owned image ticket. Inventory that ticket in the producer aggregate until full consumer acknowledgment, then transfer/release it; original sequence ownership remains separate. An empty cursor does not erase this result ticket. Empty spans retain no image. A generic ResourceRef lease identifies one owned ticket; distinct retained tickets require distinct lease identities even if their underlying Heap image handle is equal.

rules.name: publication
rules.requirement: Serialize authorizePublication with the actual destination commit. Cancel/revision changes revoke the permit. Record published/notPublished/unknown truthfully, retaining achieved storage; unknown prevents blind retry. No atomic rollback is assumed.

rules.name: failures
rules.requirement: Keep modeled Failure, generated outer SDK ComputeError, and fatal/unknown host disposition distinct. Source transitions preserve achieved custody, but that alone does not prove a generated export preserves by-value state on lowering overflow. An operational binding must demonstrate retained arena, usage, tickets, cleanup owners and pending receipts on every actual ABI failure. Do not retire or retry a lost/unknown instance; retain externally registered leases and achieved storage for reconciliation. No universal allocation-trap recovery is promised.

rules.name: qualification
rules.requirement: Historical22-root export and earlier33-machine VM controls retain their exact source scope. Current semantic ReadyTransfer migration source-checks/builds its45-module compositions; its51 controls and broad axiom annotations remain unexecuted/unaudited while an identified upstream ReferenceSemantics theorem blocks kernel compilation. Four additional machine mutations are registered in the actual runtime gate but their rejection is unexecuted. Separate input/output/report/frontend receipts do not establish this current machine graph or complete operational ABI, native/browser or pinned SDK acceptance.

rules.name: numeric fields
rules.requirement: Render View.numberFields only where present, as labeled decimal text inputs with source text/unit/optional/enabled/inputMode. Submit the raw text and exact BoundLimit to editLimitText, then render NumberEdit.message and its updated View. The source parses arbitrary-length decimal naturals, rejects malformed text and stale bindings, and owns quota semantics. Empty optional output/storage quotas impose no additional product ceiling; runtime addressability and actual host admission remain distinct.

rules.name: result variants
rules.requirement: Workspace.invokeUser returns Invocation and preserves its applied/stale disposition, state, effects and message. Workspace.dispatch/receiveRuntime return Update with state and effects. They are distinct generated sum/record types; do not deserialize or discard their fields as if identical.

rules.name: retirement
rules.requirement: Effect.requestInstanceRelease requests retirement. It is not permission to destroy the instance. Evaluate each actual retained generated owner through its source ReleaseDisposition root, including returned Steps whose effects/receipts have not been consumed. Keep the instance alive while any registered lease, arena/span owner, pending I/O, achieved/reserved storage, publication disposition, retired job or cleanup effect survives. A decoded or cancelled machine terminal still owns its Arena until moveTerminal transfers it. Unknown/fatal host dispositions quarantine the generation and preserve external cleanup owners; they never imply rollback.

rules.name: constructor closure
rules.requirement: Bind exact generated argument/result types and every reachable structure field and sum constructor, including outer SDK ComputeError. Instantiate and retain values in the generated native library; user input carries only generated BoundUserIntent or BoundLimit. Runtime/resource replies and Ready/arena/usage carriers remain trusted internal transfers. No caller-provided state snapshots are validation evidence.

rules.name: charged comparison
rules.requirement: ComparisonOwner owns one actual terminal arena and retains original/output roots throughout comparison. It reserves a real fixed control before initializing either reader, pays each initialization and every attempted shared RuntimeImage getter, and retains a paid left byte if the right quote is refused. Resume charges only the pending right read. No equality follows from pending, cancelled, failed or incomplete work. Consume achieved delta receipts before another mutation, drain the comparison control, then move the actual terminal once. These internal steps never require a user approval dashboard. A pairwise equality observation alone is not an archive/certificate/optimality claim.

rules.name: bounded payload admission
rules.requirement: The host reports immutable bounded LeaseReady metadata before copying payload bytes into the generated runtime. The source allocates fixed control and reserves the exact image before emitting requestPayload. Only then supply the same lease bytes to commit; do not build a whole input image, pre-materialize every candidate, or turn the transport quantum into a total feature size limit. Copy buffers, logical arena ownership and spool/staging storage have separate admission/accounting.

rules.name: payload ownership transfer
rules.requirement: ReadImage.Transition returns the single achieved Arena, Usage, actual Heap.Delta, cursor and Outcome. Keep the same actual arena through the internal controller; do not retain a second parser/admission snapshot. A transferred Span has one owned image ticket even if the cursor is empty. Move that ticket into the producer/CallerRoots aggregate before acknowledgment. Keep external payload lease custody distinct; ResourceRef is never cast into a Heap handle. The controller registers a real host attachment for the returned image and delivers an actual ResourceIO.ReadReply, then releases it only on full consumer acknowledgment.

rules.name: payload cancellation
rules.requirement: A refused commit leaves the same reservation and immutable external lease; the generic host retains that callback for source-directed retry without rereading or allocating a replacement lease. Cancellation retains pending read/payload requests until actual late reply or matching stopped=true receipt. Deliver source releaseLease commands and matching achieved acknowledgments. Rejected incoming leases are explicit cleanup obligations. Idempotent close requires cursor and unconsumed Outcome custody both settled.

rules.name: bounded output dependency
rules.requirement: The generic host may copy source-requested bounded bytes and attach a lease; it must not traverse Heap nodes or invent output progress. The shared Core checked span-to-Bytes accessor and its non-materializing copy quote, followed by source-paid bounded extraction and actual partial-write receipts, are required for the output bridge. The existing scalar getter and historical whole-buffer BinaryProgram do not establish that binding.

rules.name: output quote/reserve/copy
rules.requirement: Use Core.RuntimeImageCopy.quoteCost/quoteChunk/copyCost/copyChunk from the actual published source. Charge quote work, validate the full source span, reserve real Product staging capacity for the quoted extent, then prepay copyCost before copying. Skip zero-length copy. The 4096-byte bound is one transfer chunk; loop across larger spans. Keep actual source image/native backing pinned until acknowledgment. Do not infer a platform-independent allocator layout or RSS bound.

rules.name: output publication
rules.requirement: WriteImage settled(None,false) proves only transport/custody settlement, never archive integrity, execution, equality, certificate or publication permission. Achieved partial failed writes remain in the actual Writer Storage ledger. Reuse the same immutable lease for short writes. Cancellation remains latched; no late successful receipt restarts output. Publication disposition comes from its actual owner, including unknown; no atomic rollback or notPublished inference from write failure.

rules.name: inspection carrier
rules.requirement: InspectionReport consumes only actual ArchiveSnapshot taken framing completion under the current inspect run. Report claims parsed only: no integrity/execution/original equality/certificate or reconstructed boundaries. Frozen I/O measurements are scoped to run, archive ResourceRef and actual archive root; unobserved physical measurement is None. Return the same actual carrier and report-control ticket. Snapshot archive/length roots live in Signal.snapshot after session phase transferred; do not drop that signal or treat session cleanup as releasing those transferred roots.

rules.name: closed frontend package
rules.requirement: Application.run returns Frame with state, generated View, effects, disposition/message, source focusId, Workspace retirement and optional publication permit in one generated constructor universe. Application.authority distinguishes factory/user/resource/runtime/observation/publisher. ResourceNotice is narrowed to actual picker/collection callbacks. The root is internal to the persistent typed host; no caller state snapshot or arbitrary Command JSON is a validation boundary. A single package solves type identity only; certified export and achieved owner retention on outer Overflow remain separate obligations.

rules.name: current export boundary
rules.requirement: The exact frontend diagnostic source/kernel and finite native render probes have independent receipts. Its certified export currently refuses Application.run certificate B at an observed derivation lower bound, not a known final certificate size. It contains no Core module and is distinct from RuntimeByteBuilder B. Do not trim any operation, field, variant, root or authority case to meet a backend threshold. No old22-root archive or render-only observation establishes current operational ABI custody.

rules.name: resident input attachment
rules.requirement: ReadController arenaBinding identifies the actual moving resident Session owner cell, not a caller-provided Arena snapshot. Compare full run/request/source/offset/ticket/attachment epoch/image handle/extent. Register a fresh same-instance mapping naming the ONE existing image ticket, with no retain. Reader.held and active span are aliases within one aggregate. Mapping release only unregisters; it never calls Heap.release. Keep actual image owner until full consumer acknowledgment/actual stop and mapping-unregistered receipt, then perform source Heap.release/releaseStep exactly once. Raw payload lease is separate. Late/stale incoming mappings remain explicit cleanup obligations with bounded backpressure.

rules.name: output reporting context
rules.requirement: OutputDelivery owns the exact WriteImage transition plus frozen accounting context. Keep selected work lane and workAtFreeze explicit; checked deltas fold once. Exact archive size, external basis, object counts and produced-output meanings come from the actual enclosing operation, never Writer.offset. Require scoped achieved transport/basis-transfer counters and preserve optional physical observation scope. Use actual settled Writer Storage, adopt it through Control.applyStorageState after matching the live run, then Control.runtimeFailed. Direct Control.fail defaults notPublished and is not the reporting path. Stale/retired results retain actual ownership and cannot overwrite a new run ledger.

rules.name: output reporting dispositions
rules.requirement: Recoverable resource refusal is suspension, not terminal failure. Early output failure still needs actual cleanup. Settled transport success continues the operation and cannot set verified or emit successful Control.completed. Preserve substantive storage/I/O failure when cancellation is also latched. Publication staged, notPublished, published and unknown come from their actual owner/receipt; failed publication copies do not imply rollback. Unknown blocks blind retry. Reporting/arithmetic/missing-observation errors retain the exact achieved envelope; generated outer Overflow custody remains separately unqualified.

rules.name: semantic terminal exchange
rules.requirement: MachineBinding consumes whole ReadyTransfer{ready,semanticBudget,semanticLedger}, calls Engine.startWithSemantic and exposes typed semanticSuspended separately from execution/archive failure. Cancellation/extension/Ready movement/comparison preserve the accepted prefix and typed refusal. TerminalControl has no Arena/CallerRoots/Bytes/Usage snapshot; ArenaExchange moves the one actual Arena+CallerRoots+Usage and any achieved pending Delta. A pending Terminal OverflowReceipt blocks detach until takeTerminalReceipt moves the actual receipt once; each result keeps explicit source-owned roots/disposition. Reattach matches run/ticket, waits for actual Delta delivery and rejects usage regression while returning both owners. Semantic fields transfer directly without zeroing or recharging native partial writes/EOF. Native IO progress is distinct from canonical semantic output/boundary/EOF coverage; Engine7cf only integrates instruction/reference prefix events. Source type checking is not full semantic/admissibility or current ABI qualification.
